release_notes: Build 136 keeps Quiz Autopilot's project-media watcher off the WPF UI thread so background batch work no longer repeatedly blocks the app while it is running.
The media watcher now polls once per second instead of every 150 ms, reducing repeated SQLite history scans from roughly seven per second to one per second.
The quiz question bank is loaded once for the batch instead of reloading up to 10,000 questions on every polling pass, and each new project is persisted only once after quiz.json is ready.

The Autopilot Needs You refresh now loads state and YouTube growth snapshots off the WPF dispatcher, blocks overlapping five-second refreshes, and only reapplies visual cleanup when the count changes.

The old five-minute Autopilot recovery supervisor and the obsolete Build 52-54 database-recovery v1 startup pass are no longer started; current Library recovery, project consolidation and database backup/restore protections remain in place.
